definition.name: Retained ${{ matrix.language }} resources across two tenants

steps.name: Install controller requirements and check closed producer scope
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_resource_tenant_isolation tools.tests.test_resource_tenant_fresh_c -v

steps.name: Authenticate fixed normal native products before executable restore
Restore the fixed historical a4 normal native products
Authenticate original Java39 public component producer
Restore original Java39 public component and unchanged compile records
Authenticate original Rust33 public component producer
Restore original Rust33 public component and unchanged compile records
Install only the pinned C guest binding tool and compiler containment
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/resource-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/resource-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Repackage retained Java39 then require both tenant lifecycles
Repackage retained Rust33 then require both tenant lifecycles
One fresh normal captured C23 greeting then require both tenant lifecycles
Retain bounded public results and explicit original compile ancestry
